To buy a gun in NZ you have to apply for a firearms licence, this includes all the usual background checks, but more importantly you have to nominate two people to act as references, one must be your next of kin, the other must not be related to you. That's just for hunting rifles and shotguns, to own a pistol you also have to be endorsed by a target shooting club and complete extra safety courses.
